protocol.hypothesis: Contemporaneous semiconductor breadth and freshness of opening-range failures add information beyond ETF/index features. Compare matched algorithms and execution, not case-month-specific rules.
protocol.panel_basis: Fixed research panel spanning chip designers, memory, equipment and integrated manufacturers. Not a historical index constituent set; no claim of PIT membership or unbiased universe selection. Fixed before this experiment's outcomes.

feature_definitions.base: Unchanged v6 causal four-ETF features and completed SOXX/QQQ regular context.
feature_definitions.timing: Base plus SOXX/QQQ minutes since latest completed close outside the first30m range, observed-ever flags, and fresh return-inside flags (outside close in preceding15m). No future extrema or session-final state.
feature_definitions.breadth: Timing plus eight individual previous-day ret1/5/20, volatility20, current return versus previous close, relative cumulative volume, regular open return, VWAP distance, recent15m, efficiency; equal-weight means, dispersion and positive fractions. Every panel member must have complete prior21 official sessions, current regular prefix and a fresh bar. Missing members cause abstention, never fabricated zeros. All three variants share this same eligible training/evaluation feature set.

protocol.premarket: Record an analysis at09:25 including prior/current panel context; WAIT_FOR_REGULAR_INFORMATION before the opening range exists. No premarket buy in this registered experiment. Arbitrary-time v4 entry remains available separately.
protocol.algorithm_definitions: Reuse v6 StandardScaler + Ridge(alpha20), HGB squared loss80iterations/7leaves/minleaf20/lr.05/l2=5/noearlystop/random814, targets log(1+net trade return). Ensemble is equal-weight raw predictions of these two algorithms; calibrate its own saved as-of forecasts. No case-driven weights or selection.
protocol.diagnostics: Other eight feature/algorithm pairs are matched ablations or component diagnostics; none may replace the registered primary after viewing results.
protocol.training: Daily00:00ET, only earlier full-session labels available strictly before cutoff; both ETFs and every retained clock of a date must be mature; latest252 eligible distinct dates, minimum120; each date total weight1. All variants use identical members. Save each day's membership and unchanged as-of predictions.
protocol.calibration: At each clock and ETF, mean of actual log return minus historical as-of raw forecast over latest60 mature eligible dates; minimum40. Choose highest positive corrected score, else cash. Ties use SOXL first. Corrections never use the current date.
protocol.entry_and_exit: Unchanged v6 flat_close: first RTH5m Open strictly after decision+30s within6min; +5% cent-rounded TP and1.5% protective stop attached; scheduled official same-day close otherwise, within14-calendar-day maximum. Stop-first ambiguous bars, gap at min(Open,stop) minus slippage. No use of future state to schedule close.
protocol.capital: Unchanged continuous ledger: one position,100% settled cash,no same-day reentry,T+1 settlement,all losses/costs/cross-month marks retained. No actual broker order.
protocol.costs: Retain5bp per side fee and5bp market slippage as research assumptions, not verified account charges. Double both and recompute price paths for a stress replay using the same primary saved actions. Official Moomoo fee schedules vary by residency and date; unknown account applicability must not justify reducing assumed costs.
protocol.acceptance: Primary only: arithmetic mean of the three regression months>=10%, every May-September month>=0, complete daily/premarket feature coverage and ledger. Cash0 fails return target. Independently report all diagnostics, full cost stress and paired date-block feature improvement uncertainty. Exposed history is not independent forward validation and cannot establish a future nonnegative-month guarantee.
protocol.uncertainty: Paired daily log-equity-return difference breadth ensemble minus base ensemble, 5000 circular block bootstraps with10-session blocks, random seed707; report95% interval for mean daily difference. Diagnostic only, never an optimizer or substitute for absolute gates.
